[Unit]
Description=Gen 7 phase 1 collector against $BENNAME, lane %i
Requires=benlane-netns@%i.service
Wants=ben-server@%i.service
After=benlane-netns@%i.service ben-server@%i.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=900
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
User=$U

WorkingDirectory=$SRC

[Install]

[Unit]
Description=Gen 8 collector against BEN, lane %i
Requires=benlane-netns@%i.service
Wants=ben-server@%i.service
After=benlane-netns@%i.service ben-server@%i.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=900
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]

NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/benlane-%i
WorkingDirectory=/home/bridgebots/work/sdb-gen8
EnvironmentFile=/home/bridgebots/work/lanes/%i.env
Environment=HOME=/home/bridgebots PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3

StandardError=append:/home/bridgebots/work/lanes/%i.collector.log

RestartSec=30

[Install]
